SELECT

    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM (
    WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region
)
ORDER BY 
    region;

To calculate the race completion percentage of Japanese drivers from 2007 to 2009, I will first identify the Japanese drivers and then determine how many of them completed races (i.e., have a non-null time) within the specified years.

```sql
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) AS total_japanese_drivers
FROM 
    drivers
WHERE 
    nationality = 'Japanese';
```

total_japanese_drivers
19

There are 19 Japanese drivers in the database. Next, I will find out how many of these drivers completed races (i.e., have a non-null time) between the years 2007 and 2009.

```sql
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.driverId) AS completed_races
FROM 
    results r
JOIN 
    drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE 
    d.nationality = 'Japanese'
    AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL;

```sql
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.driverId) AS completed_races
FROM 
    results r
JOIN 
    drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN 
    races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE 
    d.nationality = 'Japanese'

FROM 
    results r
JOIN 
    drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId

WITH colusa AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(Case When Charter = 1 Then 1 Else 0 End) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5) AS HighFRPMCount,
        (SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgFreeMealCount,
        (SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm."School Code"
    WHERE 
        schools.County = 'Colusa'
),
humboldt AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(Case When Charter = 1 Then 1 Else 0 End) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5) AS HighFRPMCount,
        (SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgFreeMealCount,
        (SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm."School Code"
    WHERE 
        schools.County = 'Humboldt'
),
sat_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        County, 
        AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS AvgTotalSATScore
    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
    WHERE 
        County IN ('Colusa', 'Humboldt')
    GROUP BY 
        County
)
SELECT 
    'Colusa' AS County,
    TotalSchools,
    TotalCharterSchools,
    HighFRPMCount,
    AvgFreeMealCount,
    AvgEnrollment,
    COALESCE(sat_scores.AvgTotalSATScore, 0) AS AvgTotalSATScore
FROM 
    colusa
LEFT JOIN 
    sat_scores ON colusa.County = sat_scores.County
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Humboldt' AS County,
    TotalSchools,
    TotalCharterSchools,
    HighFRPMCount,
    AvgFreeMealCount,
    AvgEnrollment,
    COALESCE(sat_scores.AvgTotalSATScore, 0) AS AvgTotalSATScore
FROM 
    humboldt
LEFT JOIN 
    sat_scores ON humboldt.County = sat_scores.County;

        SUM(Case When Charter = 1 Then 1 Else 0 End) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,

        (SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools

        frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm."School Code"
    WHERE 
        schools.County = 'Colusa'

    SELECT 
        SUM(Case When Charter = 1 Then 1 Else 0 End) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5) AS HighFRPMCount,
        (SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgFreeMealCount,
        (SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm."School Code"

        schools.County = 'Humboldt'
),
sat_scores AS (

        County, 
        AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS AvgTotalSATScore

Now that I have the total loans and loans with no issues for each region and loan size category, I need to calculate the percentage of loans with no issues for each category. I will also calculate the overall average percentage to compare each region's performance. 

```sql
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan

        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN

        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

        SUM(Case When Charter = 1 Then 1 Else 0 End) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,

    FROM 
        schools

        frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm."School Code"

    SELECT 
        SUM(Case When Charter = 1 Then 1 Else 0 End) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5) AS HighFRPMCount,
        (SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgFreeMealCount,
        (SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm."School Code"
    WHERE 
        schools.County = 'Humboldt'
),
sat_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        County, 
        AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS AvgTotalSATScore

        schools

        satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds

)

        (SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm."School Code"

        schools.County = 'Humboldt'

sat_scores AS (

        County,

    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM

        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)

WITH colusa AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(Case When Charter = 1 Then 1 Else 0 End) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5) AS HighFRPMCount,
        (SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgFreeMealCount,
        (SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm."School Code"
    WHERE 
        schools.County = 'Colusa'
),
humboldt AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(Case When Charter = 1 Then 1 Else 0 End) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5) AS HighFRPMCount,
        (SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgFreeMealCount,
        (SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm."School Code"
    WHERE 
        schools.County = 'Humboldt'
),
sat_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        County, 
        AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS AvgTotalSATScore
    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
    WHERE 
        County IN ('Colusa', 'Humboldt')
    GROUP BY 
        County
)
SELECT 
    'Colusa' AS County,
    TotalSchools,
    TotalCharterSchools,
    HighFRPMCount,
    AvgFreeMealCount,
    AvgEnrollment,
    COALESCE(sat_scores.AvgTotalSATScore, 0) AS AvgTotalSATScore
FROM 
    colusa
LEFT JOIN 
    sat_scores ON colusa.County = sat_scores.County
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Humboldt' AS County,
    TotalSchools,
    TotalCharterSchools,
    HighFRPMCount,
    AvgFreeMealCount,
    AvgEnrollment,
    COALESCE(sat_scores.AvgTotalSATScore, 0) AS AvgTotalSATScore

        SUM(Case When Charter = 1 Then 1 Else 0 End) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,

    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm."School Code"

        schools.County = 'Colusa'

    SELECT 
        SUM(Case When Charter = 1 Then 1 Else 0 End) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5) AS HighFRPMCount,
        (SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgFreeMealCount,
        (SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm."School Code"
    WHERE 
        schools.County = 'Humboldt'
),
sat_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        County, 
        AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS AvgTotalSATScore
    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds

Now that I have the total loans and loans with no issues for each region and loan size category, I need to calculate the percentage of loans with no issues for each category. I will also calculate the overall average percentage to compare each region's performance. 

```sql
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
```

The result provides the percentage of loans with no issues for each region and loan size category, along with the overall average percentage. Now, I can finalize the answer by presenting the required data.

FINAL ANSWER
```sql

    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
```

WITH colusa AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(Case When Charter = 1 Then 1 Else 0 End) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5) AS HighFRPMCount,
        (SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgFreeMealCount,
        (SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm."School Code"
    WHERE 
        schools.County = 'Colusa'
),
humboldt AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(Case When Charter = 1 Then 1 Else 0 End) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5) AS HighFRPMCount,
        (SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgFreeMealCount,
        (SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm."School Code"
    WHERE 
        schools.County = 'Humboldt'
),
sat_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        County, 
        AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS AvgTotalSATScore
    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
    WHERE 
        County IN ('Colusa', 'Humboldt')
    GROUP BY 
        County
)
SELECT 
    'Colusa' AS County,
    TotalSchools,
    TotalCharterSchools,
    HighFRPMCount,
    AvgFreeMealCount,
    AvgEnrollment,
    COALESCE(sat_scores.AvgTotalSATScore, 0) AS AvgTotalSATScore
FROM 
    colusa
LEFT JOIN 
    sat_scores ON colusa.County = sat_scores.County
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Humboldt' AS County,
    TotalSchools,
    TotalCharterSchools,
    HighFRPMCount,
    AvgFreeMealCount,
    AvgEnrollment,
    COALESCE(sat_scores.AvgTotalSATScore, 0) AS AvgTotalSATScore
FROM 
    humboldt
LEFT JOIN 
    sat_scores ON humboldt.County = sat_scores.County;

                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan

            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id

            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id

I will first check the Laboratory table to find the PLT values and then filter for patients diagnosed with MCTD.

FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400;
